🚔 PC Andrew Harper was 28. Married four weeks. Dragged to his death behind a car.

Now, under Andy Burnham's early release scheme, two of his killers could be free after just 6½ years. His widow Lissie changed the law so police killers face life. This is how it's repaid.

Over 500,000 people have signed the petition to stop it — and PC Harper's own force is weighing legal action against the Government.

Reform UK's position is simple: attack or kill those who protect us and you serve every day of your sentence. Justice should mean justice.

Read the full piece 👇
